data.name: Divanshu
data.gender_notes: Divanshu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Divanshu is a Sanskrit and Hindu name that means 'Lord of the House'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'diva' (god) and 'anshu' (house or abode). The name signifies the presence of the divine in one's home and life. The name Divanshu carries the meaning “Lord of the House” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Divanshu usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the house and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Divanshu is a spiritual name that represents the divine presence in one's home and life. It is believed to bring blessings of wisdom, intelligence, and power.
data.etymology: Divanshu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the House.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Divanshu total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
